merge(left: List[int], right: List[int]) -> Pipe[int] is
    let at_left mut = 0
    let at_right mut = 0

    while at_left < left.count /\ at_right < right.count do
        if left[at_left] <= right[at_right] then
            yield left[at_left]
            at_left = at_left + 1
        else
            yield right[at_right]
            at_right = at_right + 1
        fi
    od

    yield in left |> skip(at_left)
    yield in right |> skip(at_right)

strand_sort(values: List[int]) -> List[int] is
    let remaining = LIST[int]()

    remaining.add_range(values)

    let sorted: List[int] mut = LIST[int]()

    while remaining.count > 0 do
        let strand = LIST[int]()

        strand.add(remaining[0])
        remaining.remove_at(0)

        let at mut = 0

        while at < remaining.count do
            if remaining[at] >= strand[strand.count - 1] then
                strand.add(remaining[at])
                remaining.remove_at(at)
            else
                at = at + 1
            fi
        od
